A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Curious by nature.
Engineer by practice.

I’m Thushar Reddy Vemula. My work spans full-stack applications, asynchronous backend services, cloud computing, and language technology.

I’m interested in the space where a useful idea meets a well-built system: the interface someone touches, the workflow behind it, and the small decisions that make it dependable.
